fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después del día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: At Hungarian border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo húngaro quizá tengas que mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote:
At Hungarian border control, you may also need to:

- show a return or onward ticket

entry.en: You may also need to prove you have enough money for your stay.
entry.es: También podrían pedirte que demuestres que tienes dinero suficiente para tu estancia.
entry.quote: prove you have enough money for your stay

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared.
entry.es: El efectivo o los cheques de viajero por valor de 10.000 euros o más deben declararse.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: When entering the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: Al entrar al espacio Schengen para estancias cortas, quizá debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas y una foto.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.
entry.es: No puedes llevar carne, leche ni productos que los contengan a países de la UE.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.

safety.en: Bag-snatching and pickpocketing are common, especially in Budapest and other cities.
safety.es: El robo de bolsos y los carteristas son comunes, sobre todo en Budapest y otras ciudades.
safety.quote: Bag-snatching and pickpocketing are common, especially in Budapest and other cities.

safety.en: Tourists have been taken to cashpoints with demands for money to pay the bill.
safety.es: Se ha llevado a turistas a cajeros automáticos exigiéndoles dinero para pagar la cuenta.
safety.quote: Tourists have been taken to cashpoints with demands for the money to pay the bill.

safety.en: There have been reports of drinks being spiked, particularly in Budapest’s bars.
safety.es: Se han reportado casos de bebidas adulteradas, en particular en bares de Budapest.
safety.quote: There have been reports of drinks being spiked, particularly in Budapest’s bars.

safety.en: Peaceful demonstrations have sometimes turned violent.
safety.es: Manifestaciones pacíficas a veces se han vuelto violentas.
safety.quote: Peaceful demonstrations have sometimes turned violent.

safety.en: Possessing, using or smuggling illegal drugs should be expected to bring a long jail sentence and heavy fines.
safety.es: Poseer, consumir o traficar drogas ilegales conlleva esperar una larga condena de cárcel y fuertes multas.
safety.quote: You should expect a long jail sentence and heavy fines for possessing, using or smuggling illegal drugs, including when transiting through the airport.

safety.en: Outside Budapest, showing affection in public may receive unwanted attention.
safety.es: Fuera de Budapest, mostrar afecto en público puede atraer atención no deseada.
safety.quote: Outside of Budapest, showing affection in public may receive unwanted attention.

health.en: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Marca el 112 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink anywhere in Hungary, though its taste can be unpleasant.
health.es: El agua del grifo es segura para beber en todo Hungría, aunque su sabor puede ser desagradable.
health.quote: It is safe to drink tap water anywhere, even in remote areas, however, due to the cleaning process the taste of the water can be really unpleasant.

health.en: Travel insurance should cover your itinerary, planned activities and expenses in an emergency.
health.es: El seguro de viaje debe cubrir tu itinerario, las actividades previstas y los gastos en una emergencia.
health.quote: Insurance should cover your itinerary, planned activities and expenses in an emergency.

health.en: Outside Budapest you will likely need basic Hungarian, as few doctors speak English or German.
health.es: Fuera de Budapest probablemente necesitarás hablar húngaro básico, pues pocos médicos hablan inglés o alemán.
health.quote: Outside Budapest you will likely have to speak basic Hungarian to communicate your needs as few doctors will have any English or German skills.

health.en: Pharmacies are everywhere, with high prices but good coverage of medicines.
health.es: Hay farmacias por todas partes, con precios altos pero buena disponibilidad de medicamentos.
health.quote: Pharmacies are everywhere, you may expect high prices, but good pharmaceutical coverage.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 112.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 112.

getting_in.en: Hungary's international airports are in Budapest (BUD), Debrecen (DEB) and Sármellék (SOB).
getting_in.es: Los aeropuertos internacionales de Hungría están en Budapest (BUD), Debrecen (DEB) y Sármellék (SOB).
getting_in.quote: Hungary's international airports are Liszt Ferenc Airport (BUD IATA) in Budapest, Airport Debrecen (DEB IATA) in Debrecen and Hévíz–Balaton Airport (SOB IATA) in Sármellék.

getting_in.en: Budapest is a railway hub with frequent trains from Austria, Germany, Czechia and Slovakia.
getting_in.es: Budapest es un nudo ferroviario con trenes frecuentes desde Austria, Alemania, Chequia y Eslovaquia.
getting_in.quote: Budapest is an important railway hub for the whole Hungary and large part of eastern Europe, with frequent trains from Austria, Germany, Czechia and Slovakia.

getting_in.en: Several low-cost carriers fly to Budapest, such as Ryanair, Wizzair, Easyjet and Eurowings.
getting_in.es: Varias aerolíneas de bajo costo vuelan a Budapest, como Ryanair, Wizzair, Easyjet y Eurowings.
getting_in.quote: There are also several low cost carriers operating to Budapest: for example Ryanair, Wizzair, Easyjet and Eurowings.

getting_in.en: Entry from non-Schengen countries can take a long time, especially on summer weekends along the E75 corridor from Belgrade.
getting_in.es: La entrada desde países no Schengen puede tardar mucho, sobre todo en fines de semana de verano en el corredor E75 desde Belgrado.
getting_in.quote: Entry from non-Schengen countries can take quite a long time, in particular in the summer months on the weekends when EU-Nationals are returning north along the E75 corridor from Belgrade, Serbia.

getting_in.en: Driving on highways requires a vignette, listed as €20 for 10 days or €30 for a month as of 2024.
getting_in.es: Circular por autopistas requiere una viñeta, indicada en 20 € por 10 días o 30 € por un mes en 2024.
getting_in.quote: It is also required to buy a vignette for driving on highways: €20 for 10 days, €30 for a month as of 2024.

getting_in.en: A hydrofoil connects Vienna and Budapest from May to September.
getting_in.es: Un hidrofoil conecta Viena y Budapest de mayo a septiembre.
getting_in.quote: a good hydrofoil boat connection operated by the same company between Vienna and Budapest from May to September

getting_around.en: Hungary has no regular domestic flights.
getting_around.es: Hungría no tiene vuelos nacionales regulares.
getting_around.quote: Hungary has no regular domestic flights.

getting_around.en: Emma is described as the most complete domestic route planner, unifying data from multiple operators.
getting_around.es: Emma se describe como el planificador de rutas nacional más completo, que unifica datos de varios operadores.
getting_around.quote: Emma is the most complete domestic route planner that unifies data from multiple operators.

getting_around.en: Intercity trains charge about 550 Ft extra for the mandatory seat reservation.
getting_around.es: Los trenes Intercity cobran unos 550 Ft extra por la reserva de asiento obligatoria.
getting_around.quote: Expect to pay about 550 Ft extra fee independently from the distance for the mandatory seat reservation

getting_around.en: A nationwide Hungary Pass costing 18900 Ft may make sense for visiting several regions or taking many train trips.
getting_around.es: Un Hungary Pass nacional de 18900 Ft puede convenir para visitar varias regiones o hacer muchos viajes en tren.
getting_around.quote: If you are planning to visit multiple regions or take lots of train trips, it might make sense to buy this at 18900 Ft.

getting_around.en: Since March 2024, people aged 65 and older and under 14 generally travel free on trains.
getting_around.es: Desde marzo de 2024, los mayores de 65 y menores de 14 años generalmente viajan gratis en tren.
getting_around.quote: Since March 2024, people aged 65 and older and people under 14 generally travel free of charge.

getting_around.en: On the Budapest Metro you must validate your ticket at the station entrance.
getting_around.es: En el metro de Budapest debes validar el billete en la entrada de la estación.
getting_around.quote: On the Metro, you must validate your ticket at the entrance to the station.

money.en: The Hungarian currency is the forint (Ft, ISO code HUF).
money.es: La moneda húngara es el forinto (Ft, código ISO HUF).
money.quote: The Hungarian currency is the forint, denoted by the symbol "Ft" (ISO code: HUF).

money.en: In Budapest almost all businesses and services relevant to tourists support card payments.
money.es: En Budapest casi todos los negocios y servicios relevantes para turistas aceptan tarjeta.
money.quote: In Budapest, almost all businesses and services relevant to tourists support card payments.

money.en: ATMs are available even in small cities and coverage is good.
money.es: Hay cajeros incluso en ciudades pequeñas y la cobertura es buena.
money.quote: ATMs are available even in small cities, the coverage is good.

money.en: Euronet ATMs typically charge 2000–2500 HUF on top of your own bank's fees, while bank-operated ATMs add no extra charges.
money.es: Los cajeros Euronet suelen cobrar 2000–2500 HUF además de las comisiones de tu banco; los de bancos no añaden cargos.
money.quote: "Euronet" ATMs will typically charge 2000–2500 HUF in addition to any charges your own bank may apply, whereas ATMs operated by banks (e.g. OTP Bank, Raiffeisenbank) don't add extra charges.

money.en: It is best to pay in forint when you can.
money.es: Lo mejor es pagar en forintos cuando sea posible.
money.quote: it is best to pay in forint when you can.

money.en: Exchange rates will likely be much worse at airports and large train stations.
money.es: Los tipos de cambio probablemente serán mucho peores en aeropuertos y grandes estaciones de tren.
money.quote: Rates will likely be much worse in airports and large train stations, so only change what you need to reach the city centre.

etiquette.en: When entering a home, shoes should generally be taken off.
etiquette.es: Al entrar en una casa, por lo general hay que quitarse los zapatos.
etiquette.quote: When entering a home, shoes should generally be taken off.

etiquette.en: Talking loudly is generally considered rude.
etiquette.es: Hablar en voz alta se considera en general de mala educación.
etiquette.quote: Talking loudly is generally considered rude.

etiquette.en: On public transportation it is obligatory to offer your seat to older people.
etiquette.es: En el transporte público es obligatorio ofrecer el asiento a las personas mayores.
etiquette.quote: On public transportation, it is obligatory to offer your seat to older people.

etiquette.en: Hungary uses the Eastern name order, with the family name before the given name.
etiquette.es: Hungría usa el orden oriental de nombres, con el apellido antes del nombre de pila.
etiquette.quote: Uniquely in Europe, Hungary uses the Eastern name order, i.e. the family name precedes the given name.

etiquette.en: Visitors are advised not to discuss the Treaty of Trianon (1920), as many Hungarians take it sensitively.
etiquette.es: Se aconseja no hablar del Tratado de Trianon (1920), pues muchos húngaros lo toman con sensibilidad.
etiquette.quote: You are well advised not to discuss the Treaty of Trianon (1920) at all — many Hungarians can take it surprisingly sensitively, even today.

etiquette.en: Displaying the red star, hammer and sickle, swastika, SS symbols or the Arrow Cross is prohibited by law.
etiquette.es: Exhibir la estrella roja, la hoz y el martillo, la esvástica, símbolos SS o la Cruz Flechada está prohibido por ley.
etiquette.quote: Open display of the Communist red star and hammer and sickle symbol, the Nazi swastika and SS symbols, and the Hungarian fascist Arrow Cross, is prohibited by law.

connectivity.en: Free Wi-Fi is usual in shopping centers and, in Budapest, most cafes and pubs.
connectivity.es: El Wi-Fi gratuito es habitual en centros comerciales y, en Budapest, en la mayoría de cafés y pubs.
connectivity.quote: It's quite usual to find free Internet access (Wi-Fi) in shopping centers; in Budapest, most cafes and pubs.

connectivity.en: 4G covers most of the country while 5G was being deployed as of July 2024.
connectivity.es: El 4G cubre la mayor parte del país y el 5G se estaba desplegando en julio de 2024.
connectivity.quote: There are 4G coverage in most of the country while 5G is being deployed (July 2024).
